messages:
Ana: idea — scarf swap + pizza lunch next Wed during all-hands week? 🎁🧣🍕
Devin: omg love both. count me in for scarf swap. what time for pizza?
Katie: noon works. can we do a tiny poll on toppings? also can someone confirm room?
Sam: I can bring a box of classic pepperoni and a veggie one. :)
Leo: +1 for noon. will bring napkins and a random holiday playlist. :headphones:
Maris: I vote for 'surprise me' pizza option so it's a grab-bag of toppings 😂
Jordan: prefer gluten-free option if possible — can we add that as an option?
Ana: good call @Jordan. ok options: 1) pepperoni 2) margherita 3) veggie 4) gluten-free 5) surprise me. React with 1-5 or reply.
Devin: 1 & 4 pls (pepperoni + GF slice for me)
Katie: 2 here. also scarf swap logistics: bring a wrapped scarf and put it on the table by 11:50? label if it's handmade?
Sam: 👍 wrapped is good. is there a price limit? maybe $20?
Ana: let's keep it low — $20ish or upcycle something you already have. no pressure.
Maris: love a low-key swap. I made a tiny tag template if someone wants to print — can post here.
Maris: (link) https://imgur.com/small-tag-sample :snowflake:
Jordan: thanks — I can print 10 tags at the office printer if folks need them.
ops-bot: Reservation confirmed — Conf Room B reserved 12/21 11:45-13:15 for "Scarf Swap + Pizza" (reservation id: R-199234).
Leo: ops-bot legend. thanks!
Devin: quick meme: https://giphy.com/gifs/cozy-scarf-holiday-3o6Zt8MgUuvSbkZYWc — scarf energy check :joy: 
Katie: kudos to Ana for organizing! :clap: also can someone volunteer to coordinate ordering the GF pizza?
Jordan: I'll handle GF ordering and pickup.
Ana: amazing. I'll make a tiny event in the calendar and ping design for a one-line flyer.
Sam: RSVP: yes. bringing napkins & one pepperoni pie.
Maris: RSVP: yes. bringing tags + one veggie pie.
Leo: RSVP: yes. playlist ready.
Katie: RSVP: yes. will bring utensils and some candy canes for decoration.
Devin: RSVP: yes.
Ana: Thanks team — see you next Wed! :sparkles: 
Jordan: also if anyone can't make it but wants to swap, DM me and I'll help ship.
Devin: neat — appreciate that.
ops-bot: Reminder scheduled — 12/20 09:00 to channel #random about "Scarf Swap + Pizza".
Ana: perfect, thread closed until next week unless people want to edit options.
